objective.statement: Make the consensus-bound Bitcoin miner the exercised workload path while preserving strict no-synthetic-work, disjoint-work, and submission-off-by-default invariants.
objective.acceptance_invariant: A real Bitcoin Core template is the only source of mining work; nonce scanning mutates only the 80-byte header hot path; the full block is assembled only after a target hit; configured network identity matches Bitcoin Core's canonical chain name; repeated/concurrent jobs cannot silently repeat the same work window; live submit remains independently gated.

observed.subject: repeated one-shot mining job
observed.source: candidate source readback plus repository search
observed.implication: unchanged template can repeat prior search work when no external allocator changes job coordinates

preserved_invariants: Bitcoin Core getblocktemplate remains the authoritative work source.
Live submit is disabled unless KEX_ALLOW_LIVE_SUBMIT is explicitly enabled.
Candidate validation remains bound to target, previous block hash, bits, and current tip before submit.
Consensus construction primitives remain independently testable.
Repository write or commit status is not evidence of mining correctness or promotion.
Prior verified evidence is preserved but cannot be rebound to a changed subject revision without replay.
A worker must not silently repeat or overlap an already-assigned search interval for the same work identity.
changes: Normalize configured network names to Bitcoin Core getblockchaininfo chain names: mainnet->main and testnet->test.
Prepare payout script, coinbase, transaction Merkle root, target, timestamp, and extranonce once per work item.
Scan only serialized 80-byte headers in the nonce loop.
Assemble the full block only after a header satisfies target.
Add negative and forced-hit tests proving the block assembler is not in the exhausted hot loop.
Run btc_miner_runtime.py directly in the M08 workflow and retain test/runtime proof artifacts.
Use a forced-unavailable RPC endpoint in CI as a negative control proving unavailable Core cannot produce a synthetic candidate or submission.

falsifiers.statement: Any exhausted nonce-window test calls assemble_block.
A forced target hit does not assemble exactly one block.
BTC_NETWORK=testnet does not resolve to Bitcoin Core chain=test.
Unavailable Bitcoin Core RPC produces a candidate, submission, or mining success state.
Repeated or concurrent jobs for an unchanged template can reuse the same default extranonce and nonce interval, causing duplicate search work.

execution_environment.github_actions_block_reason: account locked due to a billing issue before runner assignment

local_mechanic_reproduction.scope: isolated Python carrier using repository-readback consensus construction and candidate hot-loop mechanics; not repository CI and not live Bitcoin Core

library_evidence_reconciliation.prior_scope: adapter, scheduler, source/compile-verifiable and protocol-shaped local RPC evidence

blocking_reasons: GitHub Actions did not execute candidate code because the account is locked by a billing issue.
No live Bitcoin Core getblocktemplate/readiness receipt has been observed for the current candidate revision.
F-M08-007 work-partitioning falsifier remains open: repeated jobs can repeat the default search interval.
required_before_promotion: Implement or bind an explicit persistent/orchestrator work allocator for extranonce and/or nonce ranges.
Prove no overlap across successive and concurrent workers for the same template/work identity, including restart/retry behavior.
Reallocate/reset work coordinates on template/tip/workid change.
Head-bound compile and existing Bitcoin consensus tests pass on an available execution carrier.
Unavailable-RPC negative control returns QUIESCED with no candidate or submission.
Live Bitcoin Core qualification receipt records IBD=false, current best block/tip, and a current getblocktemplate for the candidate execution environment.
Candidate subject, environment, test plan, and evidence are reconciled to the same revision before promotion.

next_route.rule: Do not merge, promote, or advance to M09 while any decisive M08 falsifier or mandatory evidence gate remains open.
